rapidity.definition: Speed, swiftness; the condition of being rapid.

rarefactions.definition: Form of rarefaction (plural): A reduction in the density of a material, especially that of a fluid.

rates.definition: Form of rate (indicative present singular third-person): To assign or be assigned a particular rank or level.

ratio.definition: A number representing a comparison between two named things.

rd.definition: Form of road (abbreviation): A way used for travelling between places, originally one wide enough to allow foot passengers and horses to travel, now (US) usually one surfaced with asphalt or concrete and designed to acco.

reached.definition: Form of reach (participle past): To extend, stretch, or thrust out (for example a limb or object held in the hand).

recede.definition: To move back; to retreat; to withdraw.

receiving.definition: Form of receive (gerund participle present): To be given, sent, or paid something.

reciprocal.definition: The number obtained by dividing 1 by another given number; the result of exchanging the numerator and the denominator of a fraction.

rection.definition: Regimen; government; the rules governing the syntax, rules of agreement of a language.

register.definition: To enter in a register; to enlist.

remain.definition: To stay after others or other parts have been removed or otherwise disappeared.

remains.definition: Form of remain (indicative present singular third-person): To stay after others or other parts have been removed or otherwise disappeared.

remark.definition: Form of re-mark (alternative): A mark that replaces another mark.

repeat.definition: To do or say again (and again).

repeated.definition: Form of repeat (participle past): To do or say again (and again).

represent.definition: To present again or anew; to present by means of something standing in the place of; to exhibit the counterpart or image of; to typify.

represented.definition: Form of represent (participle past): To present again or anew; to present by means of something standing in the place of; to exhibit the counterpart or image of; to typify.

represents.definition: Form of represent (indicative present singular third-person): To present again or anew; to present by means of something standing in the place of; to exhibit the counterpart or image of; to typify.

resistance.definition: The act of resisting, or the capacity to resist.

respond.definition: To say something in return; to answer; to reply.

responds.definition: Form of respond (indicative present singular third-person): To say something in return; to answer; to reply.

rest.definition: To cease from action, motion, work, or performance of any kind; stop; desist; be without motion.

resultant.definition: Anything that results from something else; an outcome.

said.definition: Form of say (participle past): To pronounce.

same.definition: Not different or other; not another or others; not different as regards self; selfsame; identical.

second.definition: Something that is number two in a series.

secure.definition: To make safe; to relieve from apprehensions of, or exposure to, danger; to guard; to protect.

sent.definition: Form of send (participle past): To make something (such as an object or message) go from one place to another (or to someone).

shall.definition: Used before a verb to indicate the simple future tense in the first person singular or plural.

shapes.definition: Form of shape (plural): The status or condition of something.

show.definition: To display or exhibit; to have somebody see (something); to direct attention to something.

shown.definition: Form of show (participle past): To display or exhibit; to have somebody see (something); to direct attention to something.

shows.definition: Form of show (indicative present singular third-person): To display or exhibit; to have somebody see (something); to direct attention to something.

si.definition: A syllable used in solfège to represent the seventh note of a major scale.

signal.definition: A sequence of states representing an encoded message in a communication channel.

signals.definition: Form of signal (plural): A sequence of states representing an encoded message in a communication channel.

signed.definition: Form of sign (participle past): To make a mark.

silent.definition: Free from sound or noise; absolutely still; perfectly quiet.

similar.definition: Having traits or characteristics in common; alike, allied, comparable.

simple.definition: Uncomplicated; lacking complexity; taken by itself, with nothing added.

single.definition: Not accompanied by anything else; one in number.

sinusoidal.definition: Having the shape or characteristics of a sine wave.

so.definition: A Mon-Khmer-speaking people of Laos and Thailand.

sounded.definition: Form of sound (participle past): To produce a sound.

sounding.definition: Form of sound (gerund participle present): To produce a sound.

sounds.definition: Form of sound (plural): A sensation perceived by the ear caused by the vibration of air or some other medium.

spark.definition: A small particle of glowing matter, either molten or on fire, resulting from an electrical surge or excessive heat created by friction.

special.definition: Distinguished by a unique, particular, or unusual quality.

specification.definition: An explicit set of requirements to be satisfied by a material, product, or service.

specify.definition: To state explicitly, or in detail, or as a condition.

speedily.definition: In a speedy or fast manner.

spring.definition: An act of springing: a leap, a jump.

stated.definition: Form of state (participle past): To declare to be a fact.

steel.definition: An artificial metal produced from iron, harder and more elastic than elemental iron; used figuratively as a symbol of hardness.

stretched.definition: Form of stretch (participle past): To lengthen by pulling.

substantially.definition: In a strong or substantial manner; considerably.

succession.definition: An act, process, or instance of succeeding.

successive.definition: Coming one after the other in a series.

successively.definition: In a serial or successive manner; one following another.

such.definition: Something being indicated that is similar to something else.

sum.definition: A quantity obtained by addition or aggregation.

system.definition: A group or set of related things that operate together as a complex whole.

t.definition: Form of time (abbreviation uncountable): The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.

taic.definition: Of or relating to the Tai people or languages.

takes.definition: Form of take (indicative present singular third-person): To get into one's hands, possession, or control, with or without force.

telegraphic.definition: Of, or relating to the telegraph.

telegraphy.definition: Any process for transmitting arbitrarily long messages over a long distance using a code, especially by means of electrified wires or radio waves using Morse code.

terms.definition: Form of term (plural): That which limits the extent of anything; limit, extremity, bound, boundary, terminus.

testimony.definition: Statements made by a witness in court.

th.definition: Form of thursday (abbreviation): The fifth day of the week in many religious traditions, and the fourth day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm; it follows Wednesday and precedes Friday.

that.definition: To a given extent or degree.

the.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.

their.definition: Form of there (misspelling): In or at a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) that is perceived to be away from, or at a relative distance from, the speaker (compare here).

there.definition: In or at a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) that is perceived to be away from, or at a relative distance from, the speaker (compare here).

therefore.definition: Consequently, by or in consequence of that or this cause; referring to something previously stated.

they.definition: To refer to (someone, sometimes especially someone who does not use gender-neutral pronouns) using they/them pronouns.

third.definition: The person or thing in the third position.

this.definition: To the degree or extent indicated.

through.definition: From one side of something to the other.

time.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.

times.definition: Form of time (plural): The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.

to.definition: Toward a closed, touching, or engaging position.

together.definition: At the same time, in the same place; in close association or proximity.

total.definition: To add up; to calculate the sum of.

trans.definition: Form of transaction (abbreviation clipping): The act of conducting or carrying out (business, negotiations, plans).

transmission.definition: The act of transmitting, e.g. data (signals) or electric power.

transmit.definition: To send or convey from one person, place or thing to another.

transmitted.definition: Form of transmit (participle past): To send or convey from one person, place or thing to another.

transmitting.definition: Form of transmit (gerund participle present): To send or convey from one person, place or thing to another.

traverse.definition: A route used in mountaineering, specifically rock climbing, in which the descent occurs by a different route than the ascent.

tuned.definition: Form of tune (participle past): To adjust (a musical instrument) so that it produces the correct pitches.

uncovered.definition: Form of uncover (participle past): To remove a cover from.

understood.definition: Form of understand (participle past): To know the meaning of; to parse or have parsed correctly; to comprehend.

undulation.definition: An instance or act of undulating.

undulations.definition: Form of undulation (plural): An instance or act of undulating.

undulatory.definition: That undulates, or that causes undulations.

unison.definition: Identical pitch between two notes or sounds; the simultaneous playing of notes of identical pitch (or separated by one or more octaves).

used.definition: Form of use (participle past): To utilize or employ.

useful.definition: Having a practical or beneficial use.

uses.definition: Form of use (plural): The act of using.

uttered.definition: Form of utter (participle past): Senses relating to expressing sounds, etc., or disclosing something.

varied.definition: Form of vary (participle past): To change with time or a similar parameter.

varies.definition: Form of vary (indicative present singular third-person): To change with time or a similar parameter.

vertical.definition: Standing, pointing, or moving straight up or down; parallel to the local direction of gravity; along the direction of a plumb line; perpendicular to something horizontal.

very.definition: To a great extent or degree.

vibrate.definition: To shake with small, rapid movements to and fro.

vibrates.definition: Form of vibrate (indicative present singular third-person): To shake with small, rapid movements to and fro.

vibrating.definition: Form of vibrate (gerund participle present): To shake with small, rapid movements to and fro.

vibration.definition: The act of vibrating or the condition of being vibrated.

vibrations.definition: Form of vibration (plural): The act of vibrating or the condition of being vibrated.

vocal.definition: Of, pertaining to, or resembling the human voice or speech.

voice.definition: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character.

vol.definition: Form of volatility (abbreviation clipping): The state of being volatile.

voltaic.definition: Of, relating to, or producing electricity.

ways.definition: Form of way (plural): To do with a place or places.

what.definition: In what way; to what extent.

when.definition: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

where.definition: In, at or to what place.

whereby.definition: By what, in which direction; how.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wire.definition: To fasten with wire, especially with reference to wine bottles, corks, or fencing.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

witnesses.definition: Form of witness (plural): Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

y.definition: Form of year (abbreviation): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

zero.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.
